//: Does an interaction (16 §3.4): what the play screen starts when the player chooses one from a menu or bumps into a closed door. `requires` is what the actor believes; when it starts, the engine tests reach and `if` against truth and raises `interaction_starting`, any of which may refuse it with a reason. The phase lasts the interaction's `time` in the actor's own time, and its effects run as it ends.
name: Use
